axes.brief:
Nixon competed in elections but Watergate conduct undermined accountability.
Focused six-question reassessment: Watergate conduct and forceful presidential administration qualify electoral and constitutional commitments. Defined succession and technical institutions remain distinct from extending fixed presidential terms.
axes.counterEvidence:

The owner-defined broader axis includes lawful delegation and direct public control; a lower numerical placement is not a regime classification. Six exact responses and response strengths remain inferred. Retained source access dates are not refreshed unless a source was actually revisited. Unchanged answers and other axes were not re-audited. Watergate conduct and forceful presidential administration qualify electoral and constitutional commitments. Defined succession and technical institutions remain distinct from extending fixed presidential terms.
